title: stellaria graminea var. palustris
intro: Stellaria graminea var. palustris, commonly known as marsh starwort, is a perennial herb belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the ability to treat colds, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of marsh starwort include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
